[SWS_CM_80100] SOME/IP serialization of signal-based network binding
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
If the attribute
SomeipEventDeployment
.
serializer
is set to
someip
then
the serialization of the payload shall be based on the SOME/IP serialization rules.
⌋
Note:
SOME/IP serialization rules are defined in section 7.2.1.9.
